[USER] User requested a tweet with three tactics on how to integrate DEI into organizational strategies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided three tactics for integrating DEI into organizational strategies:  
1. Make DEI a core part of your mission and values, and embed it into all aspects of your work.  
2. Develop and implement comprehensive DEI policies and practices, including training and resources for employees.  
3. Engage with and actively seek input from diverse stakeholders, including employees, customers, and community members.

When individuals feel included and valued, they are more likely to be engaged, productive, and bring their full selves to work. This leads to increased collaboration, creativity, and success.
